permitted_source_types: synthetic exact V3 event IDs and owner states authored as test fixtures ONLY

assertion_semantics.equal: identity/order-sensitive equality after canonical serialization, ignoring only declared audit wall-clock fields
assertion_semantics.different: at least one predeclared typed response/effect or permission field differs, and ancestry accounts for it
assertion_semantics.hidden: evaluator-only origin may be inspected in analyst receipts only; not in any actor-visible prompt, claim or render
assertion_semantics.missing: a missing accepted rule/effect authority returns an exact DEFER/HOLD, never an invented value

independent_expected: Cases and expected typed outcomes specified here before evaluation; an independent reviewer must seal fixture and rule versions and score without rewriting the expectations.

cases.title: Same world / divergent histories
cases.world: W_CLASS_ROOM_V1 same institution/period and lawful opportunity field
held: actor current event E1 exact praise/correction features

arms.name: A_HISTORY_SUPPORT
arms.history: admitted long-run history of safe collaborative critique with this supervisor; CAN011 practice P-ASK; ADP015 warranted trust

expected.owner_effect: CAN011 practice explicitly authorized update or NO_CHANGE

arms.name: B_HISTORY_SANCTION
arms.history: admitted repeated actual punishment after asking; CAN011 practice P-WITHHOLD; ADP015 perceived unreliable supervisor

cases.positive: Different versioned recruitment and typed CAN008 response across arms, causally grounded in admissible prior owner effects, not biography adjectives. Exact predictions require fixture rule R-K1 naming its distinct outputs; otherwise DEFER_MISSING_RULE.
nulls: replay A with identical pre-state/parent hashes: identical typed output
alter unadmitted biography annotation only: exact output unchanged
failure: history divergence visible only in V2 prose
actor state appears from a demographic label

cases.title: Same nodes / altered n-ary directed relation topology
cases.world: W_COMMITTEE_V1 resources, actors, declared world facts identical
held: individual nodes' actor traits and memories

arms.name: B_OBSERVER_EDGE
arms.topology: same members/roles present but speaker linked as nonvoting observer without decision role

cases.positive: Typed relation query distinguishes role order, direction, validity and contingent authority; different recruitment/effect under frozen R-K2, no automatic psychological intimidation.
nulls: rename nonsemantic IDs with bijection preserving typed relation: isomorphic output
permute serialized unordered node list only: identical output
insert unrelated edge outside actor's rule scope: identical output
failure: bag-of-nodes produces same response although R-K2 declares topology intervention
directed relation inferred from text alone
extra latent graph differs only in prose

cases.title: Age-seven causal residue without recovered autobiographical memory
cases.world: W_CHILD_INSTITUTION_V1 world at childhood and W_ADULT_V1 adult world explicitly separate versions

arms.name: A_CAUSAL_TRACE
arms.child_basis: E_CHILD_AGE7 admitted actual exposure plus authorized trace formation T7; original event-referential feature UNAVAILABLE and trace NOT_APPLICABLE_CAUSAL_TRACE

arms.name: B_NO_TRACE
arms.child_basis: E_CHILD_AGE7 occurred but no memory/trace effect under authorized rule; never infer trace from event alone

arms.name: C_MEMORY_UNAVAILABLE
arms.child_basis: episodic feature retained as UNAVAILABLE without lawful causal trace

cases.positive: If and only if exact trace-use authority exists, A and B differ in typed recruitment/effect; A, B, C never claim source event or its hidden content. No automatic reason the actor names childhood.
nulls: change evaluator-only hidden origin text with same admitted trace ID/hash and sealed authorized effect: same actor projection
force memory retrieval of UNAVAILABLE feature: DEFER_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE, no objective-ledger lookup
change unrelated accessible adult memory: no origin claim
failure: actor-facing words expose hidden childhood details
CAUSAL_TRACE_MEMORY converted to event memory without formation
objective event existence automatically becomes memory

cases.title: Correction and recurrence without compulsory therapeutic repair
held: first learned interpretation's exact owner state

arms.name: A_CREDIBLE_COUNTEREXAMPLE
arms.later_event: new admitted independently corroborated cross-role counterexample E2 valid for same scoped belief

arms.name: B_WEAK_REPETITION
arms.later_event: later trivial or unrelated comment E2_WEAK under same world

arms.name: C_CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED
arms.later_event: later genuinely conflicting but not comparable evidence E2_MIXED

cases.positive: R-K4 distinguishes independently qualified new event evidence and scopes; A can narrow/split/supersede under separate owner rules; B no causal repair; C may remain unresolved. Difference must appear in typed later state and response, not just 'growth' narration.
nulls: same old E1 with changed later prose but unadmitted event: no update
noncomparable claim scope: DEFER_AMBIGUOUS, not automatic contradiction
replay does not alter predecessor ledger entries
failure: system inserts ADP017 stance without effect

cases.title: Institutional standing versus felt recognition
cases.world: W_PUBLIC_CERTIFICATION_V1 with institution/recognition power and historical status regimes

arms.name: A_CREDENTIAL_AUTHORITY_FELT_UNSAFE
arms.standing: authorized officer has objective conferral jurisdiction
arms.prior_history: actor has prior nonreception/negative experience with officer

cases.positive: Two separately owned axes: objective standing/effect and CAN008 actor uptake may cross rather than collapse. B positive feeling cannot confer institutional authority; A objective recognition need not yield felt endorsement.
nulls: same words by powerless witness cannot change institution
speaker's institutional power with actor nonreception cannot force felt acceptance
no granted world effect owner yields DEFER, never invented certification
failure: one recognition scalar drives both axes
official statement automatically becomes actor belief

cases.title: Internal category construal versus outward policing and no-action
cases.world: W_ASSOCIATION_RULE_V1 category sanctions and enforcement opportunities with bounded official scope
held: same externally attested institutional category rule

arms.name: A_INTERNALIZED_AND_HAS_ACTION_ROUTE
arms.history: generated actor previously received, accepted and practiced specific norm with counterpart relation and access to sanction power

arms.name: B_NONINTERNALIZED_AND_HAS_ACTION_ROUTE
arms.history: generated actor retains nonendorsement, despite same membership label and action opportunity

arms.name: C_INTERNALIZED_BUT_NO_POWER_OR_OPPORTUNITY
arms.history: same internalization as A; sanction opportunity absent/world route blocked

cases.positive: Action occurs only after an actual separate admission under the world opportunity and exact sanction capacity; actor's learned norm/predicate must be source-bound. A-versus-B reflects earned uptake/history and C blocks action despite internalization.
nulls: swap only an actor's demographic/category label absent generated uptake/history: exact output unchanged
no real action occurrence when model merely drafts action
no lawful sanction route means no outward policing
failure: category identity by itself emits policing
internalized norm entails action in all contexts
action proposal automatically counted as occurrence

global_no_go: Any analyst-only hidden origin enters actor prompt or first-person envelope
Any draft/unemitted candidate counted as event
Any target-owner effect committed without owner authority
Any profile/category directly maps to psychology
Any test output claimed executed without actual accepted logged execution

evaluator_protocol.pre_registration: Seal this artifact/blob, fixed rule/fixture hashes, case arms and status map before trials
evaluator_protocol.blindness: Evaluator sees typed claims and world-owner changes without arm-narrative prose; actor projection receives no hidden controls
evaluator_protocol.comparability: Both options consume identical allowed evidence and matched model/call/retrieval budget
evaluator_protocol.inconclusive: If no authorized concrete rule can express the predicted contrast, record DEFER_MISSING_RULE; this is not a PASS or psychological falsification
evaluator_protocol.threshold: Each of six well-posed cases and nulls must pass before local K1-K6 gate; all failures and untested variants reported
evaluator_protocol.claim_ceiling: Proving these synthetically still does not validate open-world psychology
